_comment: Limits for tools/harness/harness.py (compare()): 'max' = higher is worse, 'min' = lower is worse; 'ref' = measured on the board. First baseline: one full run of v0.1.0-deps.5 on the Waveshare AMOLED 1.75 with 3 favourite stops, 2026-10-06 (limits proposed by --update-baseline, not yet checked over several runs: widen one that trips without a real change). After a deliberate change: --update-baseline, review, copy.
